name: @useyolo/agent-claude-code
description: Official Yolo agent plugin: answers a screen's request with the Claude Code the owner already runs and signed in to on the media node's machine, through its own Yolo MCP connection

summary.en: Answers what you ask on a screen with the Claude Code signed in on the home machine.
summary.zh: 用家里电脑上已登录的 Claude Code 回答你在屏幕上提的请求。

summary.en: Ask for anything on a screen; links always play
summary.zh: 在屏幕上随便问；链接随时都能播放

privacy.en: Sends what you ask and what is playing to Anthropic, through your own Claude Code.
privacy.zh: 通过你自己的 Claude Code，把你的请求和正在播放的内容发给 Anthropic。
